_comment: OPTIONAL LOCAL OVERRIDE for prebuilt engine resolution. In production the manifest is published as an `engines.json` release asset (per release tag) and fetched by lifecycle.ensure_engine; it is NOT committed here. Add real rows to this file only to pin engines locally for development, testing, or an air-gapped mirror: lifecycle._load_engine_manifest reads real rows here first, before the release-hosted manifest. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Each real row is keyed '<component>-<os>-<cpuArch>-<tier>' and carries: component (llama-server|whisper-server), os (linux|windows), cpuArch (x86_64), tier (gpu|cpu), url, sha256 (of the downloadable archive), builtFromCommit (the pinned submodule commit the asset was built from), cudaArchs (embedded SM archs), cudaMajor, and libs (bundled runtime-lib filenames staged alongside the binary).
